questions.q: Which invention let anyone send a letter for a penny?
Where was the Crystal Palace first built?
Give one Victorian invention we still use.
questions.a: Stamps, postboxes, telephones, light bulbs, sewers, railways

questions.q: Core: Make an invention fact card for three inventions (date, what it did, impact then, legacy now).
questions.a: Three accurate cards with impact and legacy

questions.q: Extend: Compare a Victorian and modern railway map: one change and one continuity.
questions.a: Change: some lines closed; continuity: main lines still run

questions.q: Stretch: Muslim scholars like Ibn al-Haytham studied light centuries earlier. How does knowledge build over time?
questions.a: Each age builds on earlier discoveries, like optics leading to lenses and cameras

questions.q: The Great Exhibition was held in:
questions.a: A) 1851. It was held in 1851 in the Crystal Palace, Hyde Park.
